response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial domain expertise through GISCollective and Green Map work, plus strong distributed systems and infrastructure knowledge from Dunnhumby. However, his C++ experience is dated (2014-2015) and limited, with recent work focused on TypeScript and Node.js. While he demonstrates strong learning ability and systems thinking, the significant gap in modern C++ proficiency is concerning for a role requiring primary C++ development. He could potentially ramp up quickly given his background, but this remains a material risk.
strengths: Deep geospatial and navigation systems expertise through founding GISCollective and developing Green Map GIS applications
Proven distributed systems and infrastructure experience handling millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby, with expertise in low-latency systems and real-time data processing
Demonstrated ability to master complex technical domains and learn new technologies across diverse stack (D, TypeScript, Node.js, C++, Java)
concerns: C++ experience is outdated (2014-2015) and limited to LabWindows/CVI and Sound Position Server; no evidence of modern C++ in commercial development
No Rust experience mentioned, which is listed as acceptable alternative; recent professional work heavily focused on TypeScript and Node.js rather than systems programming languages

No explicit experience with routing tile generation, map data optimization pipelines, or routing algorithms; geospatial work appears more focused on data collection than production data transformation
